propositions: Plan-review gate currently exempts all bug tickets from substantive review, short-circuiting to bare exempt-PASS with no LLM calls or findings
FixedBench shows 35-65% over-action rate but plan-review gate has no criterion to detect whether a proposed change is actually needed
New advisory criterion 'necessity' should flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing motivation or reproduction steps
Bug tickets should undergo lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only) instead of being gate-exempt
Necessity criterion must apply to bugs (not suppressed) and run as single-turn LLM judgment on plan text, distinct from asserted-capability which checks existing implementations
Advisory->blocking promotion for both necessity and bug tier requires dogfood monitoring via standing recorder with operator attestation, not config flags
